hypothesis: With the additional 0044 final-curve rejection removed, lowering the EGO per-axis planning max_velocity from 1.2 to 0.8 may reduce the measured reference/PX4 speed and tracking lag and may change the visual residual cost around the same route segment. This is a measured comparison, not an assumption that 0.8 is a total-speed cap.

held_fixed.source_flow: EGO upstream single feasibility check plus one time-reallocation/refinement attempt; active patch 0044 remains absent
held_fixed.goal: same +16.0 m ENU, +0.10 m, +0.20 rad single goal; 3 s arrival dwell; 600 simulated-second active hold
held_fixed.health_policy: unchanged; max_normalized_cost=1.0 remains provisional; no health/freshness threshold change
held_fixed.ground_truth: read-only offline evaluation; no online truth in control
held_fixed.contact_overlay: read-only observation; no collision geometry changes

measurements: effective loaded EGO parameters and launch/runtime identity
planner B-spline acceptance and native action result
EGO command and PX4 local-position vector-speed maxima from their full stored histories; report per-axis command components separately from vector norm
fixed preflight SE(3) READY-command to truth-IMU tracking error using the same analyzer as #353
normalized-cost and VINS residual/feature telemetry at the first quality event, with the unchanged configured threshold
independent true goal error, continuous 3 s dwell, 600 s ACTIVE hold if reached, map/source freshness, contact events, and landed/disarmed/control-disabled terminal readback
controlled braking only if the task reaches its required brake-measurement point; otherwise mark not measured

decision_rules.sample_validity: A sample may still be diagnostically useful if the action aborts, provided its cause and safety terminal state are independently read back.
decision_rules.formal_qualification: Not granted by planner spline emission or speed observation. Requires all applicable N10.3 calibration evidence and the original acceptance contract.
decision_rules.health_lockout: Preserve fail-closed behavior and record it; do not change the normalized-cost threshold based on this trial.
decision_rules.speed_interpretation: The 0.8 m/s/axis planner value is not an external vehicle speed guard and does not imply total vector speed <=0.8 m/s.

procedure.safety_stop: Stop only this project container after 6 s independent readback confirms bridge LANDED or DISABLED, landed=true, armed=false, control_enabled=false, and zero control samples.
